title: Forecast Topic Coverage Balance
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:journal topic_name=*
| stats count as items by topic_name
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how journal forecasts split across topic for topic coverage.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside topic coverage.
implementation: Capture each journal forecasts event in `forecast:journal` and normalize `topic_name` so Splunk can compute the share by topic.
visualization: Table of topic with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how journal forecasts are divided across topic so you can tell if one part of topic coverage is taking over.
